description: This file defines data structures, inline functions, and macros for managing and accessing arena statistics within jemalloc, including atomic operations, mutex handling, and statistical counters for memory arenas.

methods.name: arena_stats_init
methods.description: Initializes arena_stats structure, optionally with mutex if needed.

methods.name: arena_stats_lock
methods.description: Locks the mutex within arena_stats if mutex is used.

methods.name: arena_stats_unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the mutex within arena_stats if mutex is used.

methods.name: arena_stats_read_u64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit unsigned statistic, using atomic load or mutex depending on configuration.

methods.name: arena_stats_add_u64
methods.description: Adds a value to a 64-bit unsigned statistic, using atomic fetch_add or mutex.

methods.name: arena_stats_sub_u64
methods.description: Subtracts a value from a 64-bit unsigned statistic, using atomic fetch_sub or mutex.

methods.name: arena_stats_accum_u64
methods.description: Non-atomically adds a value to a statistic, external synchronization required.

methods.name: arena_stats_read_zu
methods.description: Reads a size_t statistic, using atomic load or mutex.

methods.name: arena_stats_add_zu
methods.description: Adds a value to a size_t statistic, using atomic fetch_add or mutex.

methods.name: arena_stats_sub_zu
methods.description: Subtracts a value from a size_t statistic, using atomic fetch_sub or mutex.

methods.name: arena_stats_accum_zu
methods.description: Non-atomically adds a size_t value to a statistic, external synchronization required.

methods.name: arena_stats_large_flush_nrequests_add
methods.description: Locks arena stats, updates nrequests and nflushes counters for a size class.

methods.name: arena_stats_mapped_add
methods.description: Locks arena stats, adds size to mapped bytes counter.
